text: Ich hatte die Erfahrung in einer Zeit, in der ich mit meiner Masterarbeit völlig überfordert war. Danach konnte ich die Arbeit mit mehr Abstand sehen und habe mir einen realistischen Plan gemacht. Seitdem gehe ich mit großen Aufgaben strukturierter um und zerlege sie in kleine Schritte.
Nope, no difference

I'm better at handling grief. My grandmother died a few months after the experience and I was able to be with her at the end, hold her hand and say goodbye without falling apart. I felt sad but also peaceful, because during the trip I had this strong feeling that death is a natural part of life and not something to fear.
i just feel like i can breathe through stuff now. like before when i got stressed i would just freeze and cry but now i kinda know it passes

Meine Reaktion auf Stress hat sich verändert, weil ich heute weiß, dass hinter meiner Wut meistens Angst steckt. Das habe ich in der Erfahrung sehr klar gespürt. Wenn ich jetzt wütend werde, frage ich mich, wovor ich gerade Angst habe, und kann dann meistens ruhiger reagieren. Mein Partner sagt, dass unsere Streits viel seltener eskalieren.

The experience was at a time when I was dealing with a lot of stress from caring for my mother with dementia, working full time, and raising two teenagers. I felt like I was drowning. During the experience I saw myself as a tree in a storm, bending but not breaking, with deep roots. That image has stayed with me. When I'm overwhelmed now, I think of that tree, and I remind myself that I can bend without breaking. I've also learned to accept that I can't do everything perfectly. Some days the house is a mess, dinner is pizza, and I don't call my sister back. That's okay. I've also asked my brother to take on more responsibility for our mother, which I was too proud to do before, and he has stepped up. I feel less alone in it now.
Gelassener bei Stress, ja

I've learned that my stress is often connected to my need to be liked. I get stressed when I think someone is upset with me. Now I notice that and remind myself that I can't control what others think.
It hasn't had an impact on how I handle stressful events, I think. I'm about the same. It was more of a spiritual experience for me and didn't touch that area of my life.
Ich kann mich in stressigen Phasen besser abgrenzen und nehme die Probleme von anderen nicht mehr so mit nach Hause. Ich arbeite in der Sozialarbeit, und das war vorher ein großes Problem für mich.

Before, every stressful event felt like proof that my life was falling apart. I had a deep belief that I'm unlucky and that bad things always happen to me. During the experience I saw that this belief is a story I tell myself, and that I've actually had a lot of luck and support in my life. Now when something stressful happens, I try to see it as just an event, not as part of a pattern of doom. It's made me much more resilient.
I meditate now and that helps

Ich bin ruhiger und geduldiger, auch mit mir selbst. Wenn etwas nicht klappt, kann ich es eher hinnehmen und einen neuen Versuch starten. Früher habe ich mich tagelang darüber geärgert und an mir gezweifelt.

I deal with stressful events much better now. The biggest change is in my relationship with uncertainty. I used to need to know what was coming, and the not knowing was what stressed me out the most. During the experience, I completely lost my sense of time and space, I didn't know where I was or who I was for a while, and it was terrifying at first. But then I relaxed into it and it was beautiful. I learned that I can survive not knowing. That has helped me with everything from waiting for medical results to job applications to my partner's long trips abroad. I still feel the uncertainty, but it doesn't eat me alive anymore.
Stress is less of a big deal now. Before it felt like the end of the world, now it's just a bad day.
Ich glaube, ich hatte seitdem einfach weniger Stress, daher kann ich nicht sagen, ob sich mein Umgang damit verändert hat.

I've started to recognise when I'm stressed much earlier, before it turns into a crisis. I notice that I get snappy, I stop eating properly and I scroll on my phone at night. These are my warning signs. When I see them, I try to slow down, talk to someone and get some sleep. It's not foolproof but it works better than before.
I'm more forgiving when people let me down, which reduces stress in my relationships a lot.

Die Erfahrung hat mir gezeigt, dass ich viele meiner Probleme selbst erzeuge, durch meine Gedanken und meine Erwartungen. Das zu erkennen war nicht angenehm, aber es hat mir geholfen, mit belastenden Situationen anders umzugehen. Ich frage mich jetzt öfter, ob das Problem wirklich so groß ist oder ob ich es mir größer mache, als es ist. Meistens ist es Letzteres.
I think I've become more stress resistant overall. I don't react to every little thing.

My psychedelic experience was a very difficult one, a bad trip at a party where I felt that I was dying and that everyone was against me. For a long time after that I was more anxious and had trouble with crowds. In the last year or so, with the help of a therapist, I've been able to integrate it, and now I actually think it has made me stronger. I know what it feels like to be at the absolute bottom, and I know I can come back. When I face stressful situations now, I remind myself of that. But it was a long road to get here.
Ich nehme mir in stressigen Zeiten bewusst Auszeiten, z.B. ein Bad, ein gutes Buch oder ein Spaziergang mit dem Hund.
It's helped me deal with my chronic illness. I have lupus and flares are very stressful. I'm calmer now when they happen and I don't panic about the future so much.

I have a better relationship with my anxiety now. I see it as a part of me that wants to protect me, not an enemy. When I'm in stressful situations, I talk to it, kind of like you'd talk to a scared child. That sounds weird but it works.

Die Erfahrung hat bei mir viel in Bewegung gebracht, was den Umgang mit Stress angeht. Ich war früher ein Mensch, der Probleme immer verdrängt hat. Ich habe einfach weitergemacht, viel gearbeitet, viel Sport getrieben und mich abgelenkt. In der Erfahrung kamen viele dieser verdrängten Dinge auf einmal hoch, besonders die Scheidung meiner Eltern und der Tod meines besten Freundes in der Jugend. Ich habe stundenlang geweint. Seitdem merke ich, dass ich Dinge nicht mehr so leicht wegschieben kann, und das ist gut so. Ich setze mich heute mit belastenden Situationen auseinander, rede darüber und lasse meine Gefühle zu. Das ist anstrengender als Verdrängen, aber auf lange Sicht viel gesünder. Ich fühle mich heute stabiler als früher, auch wenn ich manchmal mehr fühle, als mir lieb ist.
I'm better able to stay calm during conflicts with my teenage daughter. I see that her anger is not about me.
I used to deal with stress by working more. Now I work less when I'm stressed, which sounds counterintuitive but it's helped.
Ich bin nicht mehr so schnell gestresst und kann die Dinge leichter nehmen.

I'm much more comfortable asking for help, especially from professionals. I started seeing a therapist after the experience and it's helped me cope with stressful times. I used to think therapy was for weak people.

I think I've become more patient and grounded in the face of stressful events. My partner and I went through IVF during the last year, which was incredibly stressful, with lots of disappointments. I was surprised at how well I coped. During the experience I had felt this deep sense of trust that life knows what it's doing, and I kept coming back to that whenever I felt despair. I let myself feel sad when a round failed, and I also allowed myself to hope again. My partner says I was her rock during that time. We're pregnant now, by the way.
Weniger Panik, mehr Vertrauen

I'm less of a people pleaser now, which has reduced my stress a lot. I say no to things I don't want to do, and I don't feel guilty. During the experience I saw how much I've been bending over backwards for everyone and how exhausted it made me.
I'm more aware of my own needs and I take care of them before I get overwhelmed.

Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich heute besser mit Stress umgehen kann, weil ich mir selbst mehr vertraue. Ich habe in der Erfahrung gemerkt, dass ich eine innere Stärke habe, von der ich vorher nichts wusste. Das gibt mir Sicherheit, auch wenn es mal schwierig wird.
Its made me less anxious in general so I can deal with stressful stuff better. Not perfect but improved

I'm a musician and performing used to give me crippling anxiety. Since the experience I can go on stage and actually enjoy it. I think I understood that the audience isn't my enemy, they want me to do well. I also learned some breathing techniques that I use before shows. Overall I'm much better at dealing with stressful situations, not just performing but in life generally. When something goes wrong, I don't spiral like I used to.
Nicht wirklich anders als vorher
I've learned to be more present. When I'm stressed, I come back to my senses, what I can see, hear, feel. That brings me out of my head and calms me down.

The experience helped me get some distance from my own drama. I'm a pretty emotional person, and I used to get swept away by every little thing. During the experience I was able to watch my emotions like weather passing through, and I've been able to do a bit of that since. It doesn't mean I don't feel things, I still feel them strongly, but I don't get as lost in them. When my partner and I had a big fight recently, I was able to step back and see that I was reacting out of fear, and I could tell him that, instead of just yelling. We made up the same day, which never used to happen.
Ich bin seit der Erfahrung leider ängstlicher, besonders wenn mehrere Dinge auf einmal schiefgehen. Ich habe dann manchmal das Gefühl, die Kontrolle zu verlieren, so wie damals im Trip.
